All 5 queued pages moved one-time from pending to done in queue.json; none were previously done and none are on the frozen list. state.json nextDay incremented 4 → 5 since the day's core work (pages + blogs) shipped cleanly with a green build both phases. Blog theme 3 ("Local citations for Canadian businesses") had no keyword data anywhere for its literal seed phrase, so per runbook section 1 it was substituted with the closest viable variant, "business directories canada" (480 vol/mo, difficulty 45), which is on-topic and unclaimed. Also fixed 2 pre-existing accuracy issues discovered during the required audit pass (stale Victoria/Vancouver keyword stats, a Victoria title overflow, and a brand-name typo) rather than leaving them in place, since these pages were already open for their one-time pass.
